text:
maya: quick sync — following the regional failover yesterday, we need a tight action tracker for DR rehearsal + runbook gaps. I started a short list below, please add owners and realistic deadlines. :clipboard:

alex: I can own the restore runbook refresh. plan: consolidate steps for full-ccr restore and add verification checks. target EOD 2026-03-30.

priya: i'll take backups verification matrix (cross-region snapshots + retention). will run a dry-restore to confirm integrity. target 2026-04-02.

liam: routing changes: propose adding weighted DNS failover + health-check gating in front of regional clusters. i'll draft the config and a traffic ramp play. owner: liam, target 2026-04-06.

sam: game day coordinator here — let's lock a 2hr rehearsal after runbook updates. tentative window: 2026-04-10 16:00-18:00 UTC. attendees: infra, runtime, sres, support. added to calendar.

erica: monitoring/alerting follow-ups: add an end-to-end synthetic for regional write+read, and a pager test policy. owner: erica, due 2026-03-29. also recommend an automated smoke-run post-deploy.

ops-bot: link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr/restore-rehearsal-2026 (auto-generated checklist) :page_facing_up:
- [ ] runbook updated
- [ ] backup dry-restore complete
- [ ] DNS failover plan reviewed
- [ ] synthetic checks added
- [ ] game day scheduled

maya: putting this into a lightweight owners table here — please reply if you want different owners or dates. i'll own tracking and weekly check-ins until closure.

alex: quick note — when updating runbook, include the KV-cache warmup step and the exact order for traffic cutover: SCALE down background jobs -> enable read-only replicas -> cut traffic -> warm caches -> cut write. i'll paste snippet in the doc.

priya: filepaths for backups i used in the dry run: `s3://redwood-backups/eu1/snapshots/2026-03-22/` and `s3://redwood-backups/ap-south/snapshots/2026-03-22/`. saw one manifest mismatch, will call out in PR.

liam: for DNS plan i'm proposing Route53 weighted records + health checks + fallback region. config example: ```
Record: api.redwood.com
Weights: eu=70, na=20, ap=10
Failover: if healthcheck(eu) == fail -> shift weight to na
```

sam: during the rehearsal we'll simulate partial region outage (network partition) and a full service die in EU. test steps will be in the runbook appendix.

erica: also add a recurring monthly failover-drill calendar invite for the oncall rotation (recurrence: monthly, oncall leads). small rehearsals reduce cognitive load during real incidents. :calendar:

maya: outstanding action items (summary):
- runbook refresh — alex — due 2026-03-30
- backups verification & dry-restore — priya — due 2026-04-02
- DNS failover + config doc — liam — due 2026-04-06
- monitoring synthetic + pager test — erica — due 2026-03-29
- game day rehearsal scheduling & plan — sam — rehearsal 2026-04-10

maya: please react with :white_check_mark: when you've started work and update this thread with PR links or calendar invites. i'll kick off weekly check-ins on Mondays until all items are closed.

alex: started — PR incoming for runbook edits, will tag @maya and @erica. :eyes:

priya: started backup validation, will push logs to the incident drive under `/incidents/dr-2026-03-22/` and open a PR for manifest fixes.

liam: drafting DNS doc now, will share a short terraform snippet and run a canary in staging.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: weekly-checkin every Monday 09:00 UTC starting 2026-03-30.

sam: calendar invite shared for rehearsal 2026-04-10 16:00 UTC. added agenda + failure scenarios.

erica: added synthetic check in Sentry and Datadog, created alert with a 5m runbook link.

maya: thanks all — i'll compile a tracker spreadsheet and ping owners with due-date reminders. closing the thread for new action items; please reopen if something slips. :sparkles:
